card.title: Sony Dualshock 4 Taking 3.4+ amps rather than 3 amps

source.title: Sony Dualshock 4 Taking 3.4+ amps rather than 3 amps

claims.statement: A DualShock 4 drawing 3.4 A+ and not turning on often has the wrong ribbon cable—10, 12 and 14-pin versions exist depending on board revision (e.g. JDS-030, JDS-011).

procedure: Fit the correct-pin ribbon (or wire it).
card.caveats: Source's '3.4 A vs 3 A' units look questionable. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
